parameters.name: DtsInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeMigrationJobs](~~208139~~), [DescribeSubscriptionInstances](~~49442~~), or [DescribeSynchronizationJobs](~~49454~~) operation to query the instance ID

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Data Transmission Service (DTS) instance. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: SynchronizationDirection
parameters.description:
The synchronization direction. Default value: Forward. Valid values:

*   **Forward**: Data is synchronized from the source database to the destination database.

*   **Reverse**: Data is synchronized from the destination database to the source database.

>You can set this parameter to **Reverse** to start the reverse synchronization task only if the topology is two-way synchronization.

parameters.name: ZeroEtlJob
parameters.description:
Whether it is a seamless integration (Zero-ETL) task, the value can be:
- **false**: No. - **true**: Yes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts start-dts-job --dts-job-id l3m1213ye7l0000 --dts-instance-id dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --synchronization-direction Forward --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zero-etl-job true --resource-group-id rg-aek2ilvoxlrdcby --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts StartDtsJob --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId l3m1213ye7l0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek2ilvoxlrdcby' --ZeroEtlJob true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceId dtsl3m1213ye7l0000 --SynchronizationDirection Forward
